content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

Selling music online is more than just uploading tracks to a platform; it requires a comprehensive strategy that includes payment processing, digital delivery, and customer management. In areas with limited access to payment solutions, leveraging cryptocurrencies and sovereign infrastructure allows creators to retain control over their sales and profits. By understanding this ecosystem, you can sell your music while ensuring that every transaction is efficient and cost-effective.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, a sovereign digital commerce stack integrates various components: hosting, backend logic, payment processing, and file delivery. Tools like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for accepting Bitcoin streamline the process, eliminating reliance on third-party platforms. By combining these elements, your music sales infrastructure becomes not only functional but also resilient against the fees and restrictions imposed by conventional payment processors.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Gumroad charges 10% on every sale; NOWPayments charges just 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Effective selling of digital products hinges on the interplay between various components. You need a reliable hosting service like GitHub Pages, a backend solution such as Google Apps Script, and payment gateways like NOWPayments that handle cryptocurrency transactions. Each component serves a specific purpose, and when combined, they create a cohesive system that supports your sales goals while minimizing operational costs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first outline your product offerings and select the right tools for hosting and payment processing. Next, deploy your store using the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack. Integrate NOWPayments for accepting Bitcoin and set up automated file delivery through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. With these steps, you will have a fully operational store ready to start generating revenue.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Retain $921 in fees with 100 sales of a $97 product using NOWPayments.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those exploring avenues to sell digital downloads without platform restrictions, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates. This comprehensive package ensures that you can set up your online store effortlessly. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Use a sovereign digital commerce stack to host your ebook store and accept cryptocurrency payments. Tools like NOWPayments enable you to process payments securely without relying on traditional platforms.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
Deploy a stack that includes free hosting, automated delivery, and low-cost payment processing. NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, significantly less than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Absolutely. By utilizing a sovereign commerce stack, you can create your own store to sell templates and fonts directly to customers without incurring high fees or restrictions.
What are the benefits of accepting Bitcoin for my digital products?

Accepting Bitcoin allows for faster transactions, lower fees, and greater privacy. Additionally, NOWPayments facilitates easy integration into your store, enabling you to tap into a growing market of cryptocurrency users.
How can I automate delivery for my digital products?

You can automate delivery by using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing and file distribution, ensuring that customers receive their purchases instantly after payment confirmation.
